rationale: One clause: appointment of Harold L. Ickes to exercise the office of Federal Emergency Administrator of Public Works under the NIRA of June 16, 1933. A one-time appointment is exhausted by performance (ruling 2026-10-28), but no held text shows he took office or when he left; EO 7064 (1935) refers to the Administrator without naming a later end. No end is evidenced. Research-only proposal; text is a working text, original not yet held; replace and re-check quotes when an official copy is retrieved.
material_gaps: Source for Ickes's assumption and departure from the Administrator office (e.g. later order abolishing or transferring the FEAPW, or official record).
